access.finding: No horizontal overflow at all 9 view/width combinations; visible 3px keyboard focus was captured at each; reduced motion kept view text unchanged, disabled transitions and avoided smooth scrolling; all paired semantic tokens and sampled rendered text met 4.5:1. Three review/stock accessible-name flags came from buttons inside collapsed details: their DOM text is present in the original markup, but the scan used innerText on descendants of closed details and therefore did not establish a real unnamed-control defect. A corrected visible-control sweep was not run.
